scope: Independent read-only review of six-actor navigation, seated transition synchronization, environment contact/cancellation and open-valve dispatch. Only evidence and temporary diagnostic fixtures written by reviewer.
sourceHeadNote: This is a local source-stage review, before a current R02 browser/public candidate is supplied. Exact module hashes are the binding.

findings.rootCause: Seat interpolation advanced root position outside the walking whole-segment actor separation check. F moved later in the same frame and temporarily masked the first overlap.
findings.fixReviewed: Seat interact/depart proposes the next shared-curve root and progress, checks the entire segment with the unchanged 15 mm gap, and commits root/pose time together only if clear. Block retains seat ownership and pose; prolonged blocked departure uses existing safe failure state.

regression.scope: Logic only, mocked native receipts; checked after each actor tick

findings.historicalReplayCaveat: The old report localReplay injects a root coordinate belonging to the previous curve into the new curve. Its progressFrozen=false is not a valid new-curve blocker fixture and is not counted as a pass. A separate current-curve fixture in INDEPENDENT_R02_SEAT_CONTRACT.json starts at 24.2737 mm clearance, rejects a proposed 10 mm clearance, and keeps root, elapsed, progress and seat ownership unchanged.

findings.rootCause: New identical root curve alone did not identify every same-mode stand retry. If the new first rendered progress exceeded the previous very small progress, NativeMotion retained the old standStart factor.
findings.fixReviewed: Workbench passes the task standStartFactor every depart frame. NativeMotion validates and uses it before the compatibility inference path. Simulation, native root prefix and full swept navigation share SeatMotionPath.seatRootOffset.

regression.scope: SOURCE_CONTRACT_FIXTURE_ONLY: actual LifeSimulation and actual unchanged prefix of NativeMotion.update; no native rig execution, images, browser or public pass.

findings.fixReviewed: EnvironmentWorld archives cancelled records without changing the actual valve angle or flow. Next closeOnly action captures current opening and requires ongoing native-palm contact to close continuously. It increments valvesClosed separately from normal watering.

regression.scope: SOURCE_LOGIC_FIXTURE_ONLY: actual unchanged LifeSimulation and EnvironmentWorld, but synthetic palm reports and a stub mechanism. No actual native palm/scene, visual, browser or public pass.
passedChecks: no palm contact holds actual mechanism
lost palm contact freezes partial valve angle
cancel keeps actual and simulated valve opening; it does not snap closed
close-only candidate remains valid in rain
close-only operates continuously from current angle and only counts valve closure

findings.failure: During persistent rain, five residents already sheltered and E cancelled normal watering. Its 12-second water cooldown led E to choose shelter at 0.6 s. By 60 s every resident was indefinitely shelter/rest, the valve remained 65% open, resource owner was null, and all six had a reachable closeOnly candidate. Idle-only scoring did not wake any resident.
findings.fixReviewed: After bottle dispatch, a bounded 0.35-second maintenance scan can assign one idle or shelter/rest resident with a valid reachable closeOnly candidate. It respects cooldowns, pending bottle reservations and execution-blocked states; it does not interrupt active contact tasks. Planter reservation remains exclusive.

regression.scope: SOURCE_LOGIC_FIXTURE_ONLY: actual unchanged LifeSimulation dispatch under persistent rain; stub mechanism used only to preserve initial cancelled-valve state. No palm, close-completion, native scene, visual, browser or public claim.

productionCallReview.windowAndValve: Workbench obtains current visible mechanism target, executes native motion, then EnvironmentWorld consumes actual reports. Opening/closing advances only under finite, poseValid, contactReady and actual handle-distance gate. Success also needs completed, current task progress and token; elapsed time alone cannot commit.
productionCallReview.nativeRoot: Workbench compares report.rootWorld X/Z with navigation state and throws above 1 mm. Shared curve and explicit standStartFactor now close the identified source mismatch.
productionCallReview.reset: Environment reset is an explicit reset boundary; it is distinct from task cancellation.
productionCallReview.weatherAndLighting: Source hook reads environment.windStrength; dusk/rain update actual light intensity/color and lantern emissive material. Rendered effect not independently reviewed in this report.
productionCallReview.geometryScope: Window/valve are assisted authored kinematic transforms. Water visual and moisture accumulator are not a fluid simulation. Navigation disc separation is not a guarantee of all limb/cloth collision avoidance.

source.limits: Exact source review and targeted production-method prefix/logic contracts only.

numeric.limits: No new complete native-bone/body run in this reviewer turn. Separate source-agent native measurements must remain separately identified; synthetic palm reports are not physical or rendered contact evidence.

browser.required: Current-candidate real browser screenshots/frames for six complete native characters, clothing/shoes/hair, sit and stand transitions, grasp/transport, mechanism interaction, environment changes and controls. R01 evidence cannot substitute.

public.required: Current-candidate actual navigation-body/resource/head evidence and applicable file/offline/public gates before sharing.

nextAction: May proceed with the planned current-source startup diagnostic and actual visual review. This report does not authorize sharing or claim R02 visual acceptance.
